description: A cosy living room corner photographed in a square format, capturing an intimate side table vignette bathed in warm evening light. Beside it, a small terracotta clay pot holds a bushy fern with bright green fronds. A white ceramic mug sits on the table surface. In the background, a linen-covered sofa with a plaid throw blanket in grey and cream occupies the left side, while a second linen chair with a similar tartan rug is visible at the right edge. Sheer ivory curtains hang at a window to the upper right, filtering soft cool daylight from the outside garden view, where blurred green foliage can be seen. The floor is a warm medium-toned solid wood in a honey-amber color. Overall palette is warm neutrals — natural oat linens, honey oak, warm amber glow and soft grey plaid accents. The whole scene reads as a damp-country-afternoon living room with layered textiles.
